note: Protocol descriptions concern ex vivo MRI boundaries. These probability-derived surfaces do not show that contrast or cellular detail.

Lateral-nucleus.text: Coronal outline changes from oval to wedge-shaped; Ba stays beside it.

Basal-nucleus.text: Coronal outline changes from rounded to L-shaped, then rounded again.

Accessory-Basal-nucleus.text: Emerges medially within Ba; CAT borders it medially and Ce dorsally.

Anterior-amygdaloid-area-AAA.text: Anterior crescent adjoining CAT; its posterior lateral extension can detach.

Central-nucleus.text: Lies above AB, with CAT medially and Ba laterally.

Medial-nucleus.text: Variable shape near the optic tract; axial views help verify boundaries.

Cortical-nucleus.text: Small compartment above CAT, with AB on its lateral side.

Corticoamygdaloid-transitio.text: Forms the medial border and meets HATA posteriorly; labels remain separate.

Paralaminar-nucleus.text: Thin band below Ba, beside CAT, extending medially toward AB.

readingScope: Human lesion findings are not a function map for the selected nucleus.
